title: How to Resist Hypnosis
description: There are lots of ways one can resist going into trance, if you really wanted to fight it, you could simply click off and get on with your day. But, if you wanted to try and train your brain to fight it, you can stay and we can discuss how one can resist trance. This is a script fill, originally written by the lovely Ryshade . The background binaurals were made by Periph <3 A playful resistance play file built around overload and increasingly impossibly confusing instructions. I’m going to teach you how to focus, drift, sink, float and how to empty your mind to keep your mind safe from me. This file does contain some sexual suggestions, as well as suggestions to write a comment after the file. The only issue is…. I need you to pay attention to me so I can teach you how to resist. I need you to follow my every instruction. Do you think you’re up for the task? Can you resist me? As always, this file is an erotic hypnosis fantasy and is best enjoyed with an understanding of subject agency. For more information on subject agency, MuttHypno has an excellent and comprehensive writing on Building Subject Agency
author: Lambellina
